description: Dashboard and user-home times now display in a configurable local timezone (DST-aware). A new TIMEZONE environment variable (IANA name such as Europe/London) controls the display timezone and is also set as the container TZ.

add.description: IANA timezone name used for all times shown on the admin dashboard and user home page (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo). Handles daylight saving automatically. Also sets the web container's system timezone.

notes: After the upgrade the web container must be rebuilt and restarted so the new TIMEZONE variable is picked up (docker compose build web && docker compose up -d web). Existing sites that leave the default will see Europe/London (BST in summer, GMT in winter). If your site is in a different zone, set the correct IANA name during the preflight prompt.
